title: RateLimitError
description: Error body returned when the per-client request rate limit has been exceeded on the Ron Swanson Quotes API. Companion to the X-RateLimit-* response headers.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the rate-limit condition.
message.example: You have exceeded the request rate limit for this endpoint. Please wait until the time specified by X-RateLimit-Reset before retrying.
